$comment: Single source of truth for the docs-factory content vocabulary. Loaded by site/src/content-core/vocab.mjs (JS) and tools/docsnip/src/docsnip/vocab.py (Python) so the controlled vocabularies cannot drift between the site and docsnip. Model element ids are NOT here — they come from the LikeC4 model (architecture/dist/model.json).
$postTypesComment: Blog `post_type`. blogs/QUALITY.md facet (a) calibrates fact density by it: an essay is carried by reasoning, every other type is fact-dense.
$topicsComment: The controlled product/topic axis for the review layer's version rows and the 'what changed for X' rollup. `topics` are the canonical ids; `topicSynonyms` folds blog `tags` spellings and doc `project` values onto a canonical id (unmatched tags are dropped with a warning at manifest time). A canonical id with no tagged content yet (e.g. duckdb) is valid — it renders an empty rollup.
$specFeaturesComment: Feature names a compatibility journey's `feature:` may cite, keyed by the open specification's model id. deltaSpec: PROTOCOL.md's feature names, then the features its RFCs specify. icebergSpec: format features in kebab-case, after the spec's sections. icebergRestSpec: the REST catalog OpenAPI operationIds. `delta_features:` frontmatter takes a deltaSpec name or a `deltaTopics` entry.
